widget.label: AI Product Recommendation Assistant
widget.description: Displays an AI-powered assistant that recommends products based on user queries

parameter.name: title
parameter.label: Widget Title
parameter.description: Title displayed above the assistant input

parameter.name: placeholder_text
parameter.label: Placeholder Text
parameter.description: Placeholder text for the AI search field

parameter.name: related_examples
parameter.label: Related Searches
parameter.description: Comma separated list of example queries to animate under the input

parameter.name: show_recommendations
parameter.label: Show Related Products Sidebar
parameter.description: Enable asynchronous related products sidebar beside the main results

parameter.name: custom_endpoint
parameter.label: Custom Search Endpoint
parameter.description: Override default search endpoint (relative to AiCore Base URL). Leave empty to use system config. Example: /rest/v1/custom-search
